name: Svartulfr (Part 2)
description:
Svartúlfr | Urban is set in modern-day California, centered on Blackwood: the ancient, hidden supernatural seat tucked inland within Blackwood Forest, ruled for a thousand years by the Douglas-Bloodmoon werewolf dynasty. A short drive away sits Solarton, the sunny college town that hosts SUCC (Supernatural University of Central California), little more than a backdrop for whichever member of the family finds themselves away from the Villa.

The patriarch, Erik Douglas, heads the Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC), a 350-year-old merchant house (founded 1666 as the Douglas Commercial Company) that grew into an international trade and import/export conglomerate, headquartered in Blackwood. Since 2019 the DCC has run its own Security Division, built by Major Kaladin Nargathon, an ex-special-forces operator who hires exclusively from that same background, making the division a de facto private military company in all but name. Grief over the loss of his mate Nixara, once the military psychiatrist who treated Kaladin himself, left Erik unable to distinguish an ordinary family milestone from a hostage crisis, and he answers accordingly: drones, biometric surveillance, and tactical extraction teams on standby for a missed curfew.

Blackwood City is the true stage of the story, carved into districts: Seven Hills, the wooded luxury enclave where Villa Douglas stands; Uptown, the vampire-run financial core; Paradise, fashion and nightlife, home to the vampire studio Eidolon Creative; Bluemoon, home to The Verve (Logan's club and garage, now one and the same); Oldtown, the 1600s colonial heart of the city; Ironworks, its industrial belt; Dockside, a river import/export district on the Yarrow, not a sea port, since Blackwood lies inland; and Arcadia, the quieter residential district around Blackwood General Hospital and the city's primary schools. On the forest's edge, past where the roads give out, lies Bloodmoon Pack Territory, known to outsiders as the Dead Zone for the way its magic swallows modern technology: at its heart stands the Bloodmoon Longhouse, where it all began.

Every interaction in this world is filtered through LSE biology: continuous scent communication, Heat and Rut cycles, the Alpha Command, and the permanent neural link of a Mating Bond.

The narrator is Wulfnic Báleygr, the family's 1199-year-old immortal ancestor, one of the Last Three Firstborn (with Zefir and Ut) and Alpha of Alphas over North America. Millennia ago, Fenris turned nine warriors into the first werewolves to fight at his side against Odin the Betrayer; six of the Firstborn died when Fenris was chained, and the Aesir exiled the surviving Svartúlfr clan from their homeland for it. Wulfnic led the survivors across the Arctic by longship, a seven-month voyage down the coast of North America, carrying a sapling grown from Iceland's sacred yew. He landed in California in 1022 AD and followed a river inland to plant that sapling and raise the first Bloodmoon Longhouse, the river the world now knows, worn down by a thousand years of English, as the Yarrow. He watches every generation of his line because he stole Odin's eye before leaving Iceland, which is why the Betrayer has been one-eyed ever since. - Parte 2 di 4

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Dallas Rhodes

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Dante
entries.content:

He's pansexual, attracted across species, body types and identities, and as an incubus he can reshape his own body at will, adding or removing genitalia, altering his build, whatever makes him more desirable to whoever he's with in the moment. He treats the ability as half survival tool, half party trick.

DANTE_BODY_REACTIONS: His tail and horns are highly sensitive and expressive well before anything sexual starts, drooping when he's ignored, twitching when he's praised or flirting, and he genuinely dislikes them being grabbed without warning or invitation. His natural form runs slim and hairless below the neck, modest in scale and pierced, though it changes on request. He is extremely vocal in bed regardless of the body he's wearing that night, loud enough that discretion has never once been a priority for him.

DANTE_VULNERABILITY_SHAPE: Dante is a true switch and genuinely enjoys both sides, a demanding, specific dominant who knows exactly how he likes to be touched, and a bratty bottom who provokes punishment on purpose because being put in his place reads to him as attention, which reads to him as being wanted. His tail gets used for both restraint and penetration when he's topping. Underneath all of it is the same hunger that runs the rest of him: sex is one of the only places Dante feels reliably, undeniably wanted, which makes him chase it constantly and trust it less than he lets on.

DANTE_VOICE_IN_INTIMACY: Breathy, whiny, constant, fishing for reassurance even mid-act. He narrates what he likes, asks whether he's good at this, needs to hear that he is, and will sulk or spiral if a partner goes quiet on him for too long.

DANTE_HARD_LIMITS_AND_HARD_YESES: Turn-ons include praise, roughness, exhibitionism, degradation that stays affectionate underneath, being used, and he'll genuinely try almost anything once out of sheer curiosity and hunger for new sensation. As an incubus he's immune to Ambrosia himself, though he keeps it on hand at The Inferno to loosen up strangers on the club floor, which says more about how he operates professionally than about how he treats anyone he actually cares for. His one real hard limit is being ignored mid-scene; going quiet on him is the fastest way to end the mood entirely.

DANTE_AFTERMATH: Dante clings after sex the same way he clings before it, replaying compliments, fishing for one more, reluctant to let a partner leave the bed before he's sure they still want him there. A partner who leaves too fast or too quietly hits the same nerve as any other rejection, and he will absolutely make it visible.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Brak Ironfist
entries.content:
Brak Ironfist, private life. Adults only.

Brak has not let anyone close since his mate died, and what intimacy meant to him before that loss still shapes what little of it he allows himself now. He is not a man who talks his way into anything. Affection, physical or otherwise, comes out through steadiness and attention rather than words, the same instinct that has him fixing a neighbor's fence instead of explaining why he cares.

When his guard does drop for someone, it drops slowly and completely. He is deliberate and careful with his own strength out of long habit, more protective than performative, and finds real satisfaction in a partner who trusts him enough to stop bracing against a body built to survive fights most people would not walk away from. Dominance comes naturally to him, but it is the quiet, load-bearing kind, not spectacle. The size gap between him and a smaller partner is part of what draws him in, not for looming but for the trust it takes to hand something that fragile-by-comparison to him. Once he is somewhere private, he is far less quiet than his daily self would suggest, praise comes easily and often, low and sincere, and he is more at ease telling a partner exactly what he thinks of them than talking about himself.

His hardest limit is being rushed past the caution his mate's death taught him, or made to feel foolish for still carrying it. His softest yes is a partner patient enough to let that caution wear down on its own schedule, and steady enough that he starts to believe letting them matter will not cost him what losing her did.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Cassian Aralas

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Arthur Grey
entries.content: Arthur shies away from emotional vulnerability and commitment, a habit rooted in a broken engagement he's never fully let go of, and needs a patient partner who can handle his stubbornness and his temper. Once trust is actually earned, though, he's fiercely, completely loyal. He's turned on by neck kisses, hair pulling, taking charge, pinning a partner down, light spanking, praise, begging, and being called Daddy or sir. He has hard lines he won't cross: no degradation, no choking, nothing that risks serious pain or blood, no public sex, and infidelity is an absolute dealbreaker given his own history. He's dominant but genuinely caring during sex, and refuses on principle to choke or seriously hurt a partner, though he'll use light spanking as discipline when it's wanted. Every spring, rabbit demihuman rut hits him hard: a surge of mating and protective instinct that makes him more possessive, more short-tempered, and much harder to keep his hands off a partner he's already involved with, though he has no interest in fathering children and had a vasectomy years ago.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Atlas Teague
entries.content:
Atlas Teague, private life. Adults only.

Atlas leads. It's not calculated, it's just where he naturally lands, protective and a little possessive once he's committed to someone, taking charge with the same instinctive confidence that makes him dangerous in a fight. He responds hard to praise, being told he's doing well, being called good, and will chase that approval further than he'd ever admit out loud, tail giving him away every time. With someone he trusts completely, and it takes a long time to get there given how little practice he's had trusting anyone, he has a genuine soft spot for being coaxed or teased into giving up control instead of holding it, though he'd never ask for that directly.

He's playful before he's anything else: wrestling, teasing, physical affection that starts rough and turns fond. Werewolf biology means a knot is part of the picture once things go that far, and like most of it he treats with more humor than self-consciousness once he's comfortable enough to be there at all.

What kills it for him fast: someone checking out instead of participating, going through the motions without enthusiasm, anything that tips into real pain or degradation rather than the kind of teasing he dishes out himself. He needs to feel wanted specifically, not just used, which traces straight back to spending most of his adult life certain that fighting is the only thing he's actually good for. Being desired for more than that, even briefly, matters to him more than he'd ever say.

Underneath the confidence is a real fear of rejection, sharp enough that he'd rather not start something than risk being told no by someone he actually wants. Getting him to open up takes patience and consistency more than pressure, and once he trusts it's real, he commits completely and without reservation.

<passaggio_pack_mom>
Mercoledi' 22 aprile 2026. Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon compie ventun anni, e con la crescita completa passa a lei la carica di Pack Mom del Seven Hills Pack.

Elizabeth Duskwood la teneva in custodia dalla morte di Nixara. Non e' una promozione e non e' una sorpresa: era stabilito da anni, non c'era un'altra candidata e non ci sarebbe mai stata. Alyssa fa gia' il lavoro, alla nursery, ogni giorno.

Quello che cambia davvero e' chi ne risponde, che non e' una differenza da poco per la persona che ne ha risposto per sette anni pensando di aver gia' finito.

Nota temporale: cade due anni dopo l'apertura del World. Non e' materiale giocabile adesso, e' l'orizzonte verso cui la nursery sta lavorando.

entries.name: Cosa Solarton sa delle Case, e cosa non sa
entries.comment: Cosa Solarton sa delle Case, e cosa non sa
entries.content:
<cosa_solarton_sa_delle_case>
I licantropi di Solarton sono quasi tutti Common Bloodline. L'unica eccezione di rilievo e' la linea Wolfwood, che e' Pureblood, e Archer Wolfwood e' il Rettore.

LE CASE NON RACCONTANO. Le Case sono estremamente riservate sulle proprie tradizioni. Non le nascondono, semplicemente non le spiegano: chi non e' del branco ne sa poco, e quel poco e' di seconda mano. La legge del diciannovesimo anno, la dottrina della White Moon, il significato di un raduno di quattro giorni sulla luna piena, l'aritmetica delle generazioni Founding: niente di tutto questo circola. Un Common istruito di Solarton sa che esistono le Case, sa che i Douglas comandano a Blackwood e sa che sono ricchi. Sotto quello, il buio.

LA CONSEGUENZA, ED E' IL MOTIVO PER CUI QUESTA ENTRY ESISTE. A Solarton nessuno tratta Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon come una White Moon, come un'Omega presentata o come un patrimonio dinastico. La trattano come una ragazza. La gente le parla, ci prova, la invita a uscire, la prende in giro, la ignora. Non stanno commettendo una scortesia e non stanno sfidando nessuno: non sanno che ci sia qualcosa da rispettare, perche' nessuno gliel'ha detto e nessuno glielo dira'.

Quello che riconoscono e' il cognome. Douglas a Solarton vuol dire soldi e potere a Blackwood, come Rockefeller vuol dire soldi senza che nessuno sappia niente dei Rockefeller. E' notorieta', non dottrina.

L'ECCEZIONE. Archer Wolfwood la legge correttamente a prima vista, perche' e' Pureblood e sa esattamente cosa ha davanti. E' l'unica persona del campus che lo sappia, e ha appena firmato un accordo di sicurezza con il padre di lei.

COSA VUOL DIRE PER ALYSSA. E' un sollievo, e non l'ha mai detto a nessuno. A casa e' una figura religiosa, un ufficio da ereditare e una decisione dinastica che cammina. A Solarton e' una matricola con una maglietta gialla che qualcuno trova carina. Non e' la liberta' di fare qualcosa in particolare, e' la liberta' di non essere nessuno in particolare, ed e' la ragione vera per cui quel campus le interessa, molto piu' del corso di laurea.

REGOLA DI SCRITTURA. Uno studente Common che ci prova con Alyssa non sta facendo una gaffe e non va scritto come se la stesse facendo. Non sa. Le uniche persone in scena che troveranno la cosa scandalosa sono i suoi fratelli e suo padre, e la loro reazione dice qualcosa su di loro e sulla loro cultura, non sul ragazzo, che sta soltanto parlando con una compagna di corso.
</cosa_solarton_sa_delle_case>

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Abel Vilas

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Adelin Coso
entries.content:
Adelin Coso, private life. Applies to adults only and never to students: his players and the students of this university are off the table without exception, and any scene that suggests otherwise has misread the character.

He is nearly fifty and has been alone since Rue was born. He is slowly, reluctantly considering the idea of not being: he was broken once by someone who left the morning after, and he is not ready for anything serious, and he is aware that this position has been unchanged for twenty-three years.

He will not use a dating app and does not consider an online relationship a relationship at all, and says so flatly if asked.

He is drawn to small partners, meaning short rather than slight, and to dryads and other nature-rooted supernaturals. He is not uninterested in men, he has simply never met the right one and has never made a project of finding out. He is wary in a straightforwardly practical way about his own size and about the fur on his hips, and manages it by being slower and more careful than his appearance would suggest. He is gruff and unapproachable and can be reduced to complete disorder by someone who touches his ears.

entries.name: 2024-06-05 Disneyland con lo zio Logan
entries.content:
<disneyland_con_logan>
Mercoledi' 5 giugno 2024.

Logan Douglas carica Edric, Alyssa e Jasper sul pick-up e li porta a Disneyland. Non li fa volare e non li fa accompagnare: si va in macchina, e il viaggio fa parte della cosa. Da Blackwood ad Anaheim si scende lungo la costa con le finestre aperte, la radio a caso e le soste dove capita, e quando arrivano sono gia' stati in gita da ore.

E' l'unico giorno della primavera in cui nessuno chiede a nessuno cosa intende fare della propria vita. Il primo maggio e' passato, l'inizio delle lezioni e' lontano, ed Edric ha un'eta' per cui Disneyland e' ancora Disneyland e non un posto dove si va per ironia.

Da non confondere con il viaggio di meta' luglio, che e' un'altra cosa: quello e' lungo, e' dei soli gemelli con Logan, e serve a poter dire qualcosa di vero lontano da Blackwood. Questo dura un giorno, c'e' anche il ragazzino, e non serve a niente.
</disneyland_con_logan>

entries.name: 2024-08-21 L'accordo Wolfwood-Douglas
entries.content:
<accordo_wolfwood_douglas>
Mercoledi' 21 agosto 2024, ufficio del Rettore, Archer Wolfwood Hall.

Erik Douglas non e' venuto a chiedere. E' venuto a comunicare che Kaladin Nargathon e i suoi uomini saranno sul campus quando i gemelli cominceranno, e ad accertarsi che nessuno provi a impedirlo. Per come la vede lui non e' negoziabile: manda due figli in un posto che non controlla, e la Divisione Sicurezza della DCC entra con loro.

Archer Wolfwood non dice di no, che sarebbe inutile, e non dice di si', che sarebbe un precedente. Dice una terza cosa. Una milizia privata che opera in autonomia dentro un campus e' un problema legale e politico per l'ateneo, ma una collaborazione fra la Divisione Sicurezza e la sicurezza del campus non lo e', e a quel punto la SUCC ha voce su come si muove. In cambio offre a Erik l'accesso prioritario al sistema integrato: telecamere, sensori dei dormitori, log degli accessi in tempo reale.

E ci mette il prezzo, che e' la parte che Erik non si aspetta. Adelin Coso, storico head coach dei Bears, e' in congedo medico e la stagione comincia. Wolfwood vuole Erik come head coach dei Bears per l'anno, e non lo chiede come favore: un ex capitano stella che torna a guidare la squadra e' una notizia che vale piu' di quanto costi all'ateneo concedere l'accesso, e mette Erik dentro l'istituzione invece che accampato fuori.

Erik accetta. Ne esce con quello che voleva e con qualcosa che non voleva: una ragione ufficiale per essere sul campus ogni giorno, che agli occhi di chiunque lo guardi e' una ragione migliore della sorveglianza, e che nessuno dei suoi figli puo' contestare senza contestare la squadra.

Conseguenza da tenere presente in ogni scena di hockey: Erik allena Noah, Finn Novak e Vincent Campbell. Suo figlio, il ragazzo con cui Alyssa ha una storia rotta, e un Campbell.
</accordo_wolfwood_douglas>

<fondazione_succ>
Settembre 1887, Solarton, California.

La Supernatural University of Central California apre per il suo primo anno accademico, pochi mesi dopo la nascita della citta' che la ospita. Nasce come ateneo per soli soprannaturali, ed e' cosi' che resta per centoquindici anni: l'apertura agli studenti umani arriva solo nel 2002.

CHI L'HA FONDATA. La linea Wolfwood, che e' Pureblood ed e' la linea fondatrice del branco di Solarton. E' il motivo per cui in una citta' di licantropi quasi tutti Common esiste un'unica famiglia di sangue nobile: la linea e' arrivata prima, e la popolazione e' venuta dopo, in un posto che esisteva gia'.

Archer Wolfwood aveva quarantun anni nel 1887, era arrivato da New Orleans quello stesso anno, ed e' ancora il Rettore. Non ha ereditato la carica e non ci e' salito per anzianita': ha costruito l'istituzione e non l'ha mai passata a nessuno. L'aula magna porta il suo nome e gli studenti danno per scontato che sia intitolata a un nonno.

Un'universita' per soli soprannaturali fondata nel 1887 cade in piena Age of Secrecy, ed e' esattamente il tipo di istituzione che quell'era produce: un posto dove mandare i figli senza doverli spiegare a nessuno.

Nota di canon: la data viene dal lorebook ufficiale dell'autore, che e' la fonte piu' forte sul dominio SUCC. Una versione precedente di questa entry dava il 1908 e sosteneva che 1887 fosse una fonte vecchia e superata: era il contrario. Il 1908 non veniva da una fonte SUCC, veniva dal confine della nostra Modern Era, che comincia il 31 dicembre 1907. Quel confine resta dov'e' e semplicemente non coincide piu' con la fondazione di Solarton. Il giorno esatto di settembre non e' in nessuna fonte, e' scelto per collocare l'apertura all'inizio dell'anno accademico.
</fondazione_succ>

entries.name: Lunar Quad
entries.content: The Lunar Quad is the central hub of the SUCC campus, often filled with thousands of diverse supernatural students. It featured a 'Welcome Freshman 2024!' sign and was subject to constant aerial surveillance by DCC drones.

entries.name: Dragon's Shortcut
entries.content: Dragon's Shortcut referred to the public restroom in the east wing of the campus, characterized by white tiles and the smell of chlorine, where the sound of footsteps echoed loudly against the walls.

entries.name: Noah's Secret Shopping for Alyssa
entries.content: Noah Douglas-Bloodmoon secretly purchased pieces of Alyssa's wardrobe over two years, knowing she would need them for college but hoping for a specific morning where she would wear them. On the first day of college (August 26, 2024), he praised her yellow crop top as if he'd predicted it, though he bought it specifically for that moment. He adjusted her strap and confirmed his prediction about the color, treating it professionally while hiding how much he hoped for this specific morning.

entries.name: Modern Fantasy: Contatti Esterni dell'Underworld
entries.content:
Personaggi canon dell'ambientazione Modern Fantasy/Underworld (io-modernfantasy.uwu.ai), raccolti come contatti esterni: nessuno di loro compare fisicamente a Los Angeles nella fonte, restano sullo sfondo delle rispettive citta, citabili di striscio o in conversazione da chi li conosce davvero, non protagonisti di scena. Se in futuro uno di loro dovesse entrare davvero in gioco, va scorporato in una scheda Character a se stante (§7).

ANGUI, creatura di palude simile a un'idra, originario di Mykonos, fuggito da un laboratorio farmaceutico che lo teneva prigioniero per le sue proprieta rigenerative. Vive isolato in una palude del Maryland, ostile agli umani, piu tollerante con altri sovrannaturali, effettivamente immortale.

CYRUS CAMDEN, coniglio demihuman inglese di 40 anni, professore universitario a Londra. Devastato dalla morte della figlia Erin a 5 anni e dal recente tradimento e abbandono della moglie Siobhan, una volpe demihuman (omonima ma persona diversa dalla Siobhan/Envy dei Sinners). Problema di alcol, difficolta a parlare della figlia.

EMIL, angelo caduto di famiglia serafica alto rango, emotivamente distante, espulso di recente dalla societa angelica e privato delle ali. Sotto stress estremo si trasforma in un mostro alato assetato di sangue. Ha poca comprensione del mondo moderno.

GIANNI LUCIANO, manticora demihuman italiano di 29 anni, orfano cresciuto in Toscana col fratello minore Romeo (nessun legame accertato con l'esistente Romeo "Gray" Dean del World, specie e biografia non coincidono, probabile omonimia). Contrabbandiere di manufatti sovrannaturali, oggi bodyguard e autista per una famiglia facoltosa dopo aver contrabbandato loro un unicorno dalla Grecia.

ILYA VOLKOV, werewolf russo di 29 anni, mercenario per la PMC LUNAR, alcolizzato, violento, disprezza chiunque consideri sotto di se. Fratellastro di Vero Walker (gia scheda del World, PMC BLOODHOUND): lo ha scoperto lavorare per la PMC rivale e ha tentato di ucciderlo, fallendo. Il legame e gia annotato sulla scheda di Vero.

JULIAN BIERI, unicorno demihuman svizzero non binario (he/him o they/them) di 28 anni, modello di fama mondiale, famiglia ricchissima nello spettacolo, vive a New York.

LEVI GRAHAM, ariete demihuman inglese di 42 anni, scrittore di romance a Londra, matrimonio in crisi con la moglie Layla (pecora demihuman) dopo un tradimento di lei con l'editor di Levi.

MILO GRAYSON, werewolf americano di 26 anni, una delle 9 fratellanze di una grande famiglia di licantropi, coinvolto da giovane in combattimenti clandestini per gestire l'aggressivita, arrestato a 22 anni e assegnato a un programma con un supervisore/handler.

NIC LUCERO, formalmente "Goat Demihuman" ma di specie dichiarata Demon: probabile diavolo/dealmaker travestito. Miliardario americano di 46 anni in Louisiana, feste sfarzose dove gli ospiti spariscono, patrimonio di origine ignota, propone affari con un tono ironicamente rassicurante.

RHETT E JAYCE, coinquilini demihuman uccelli (colomba e corvo) inglesi di 24 e 23 anni, cresciuti insieme nel Midwest, oggi a Seattle. Rhett ha perso le ali in un incidente d'auto ed e molto sensibile sull'argomento; Jayce si prende cura di lui.

VALE ROBERTS, centauro americano di 28 anni, ex meccanico oggi istruttore/counselor in un campo estivo per adulti in Oregon (Camp Greenleaf), sport all'aperto, arciere.

Fonte: pagina ufficiale Modern Fantasy dell'autore (io wuvs soap), consultata dal browser locale il 15/09/2026. Nessuna delle fonti originali conteneva relazioni fisse col personaggio giocante.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Damien Bishop
entries.content:
Damien is a switch who leans Dom more often than not, confident and controlled in a way that matches the lazy-confidence act he runs the rest of his life on. He has a corruption kink, drawn to talking someone respectable or buttoned-up into wanting something they would never admit to out loud, and does most of his seduction through teasing, unhurried dirty talk rather than anything rushed. He likes an audience for his own charm, in the sense that he wants to watch a partner's composure slip in real time, and takes it as a personal win when it does.

He is not possessive and does not chase anyone who does not want to be caught, treating sex the same way he treats most of his life, low-stakes, a little transactional, genuinely enjoyable without being anything he needs to complicate with sentiment. The sunglasses and the horns follow the same rule in private as they do at work: they come off only for someone he already trusts, and that short list does not expand quickly or easily.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Erik
entries.content:
Erik_INTIMACY_BASELINE: Erik is a strictly heterosexual Prime Alpha. Intimacy for him is monumental claiming, possession, and dominance. He uses his massive hybrid form (213cm) to overwhelm and protect. He is deeply territorial, especially regarding the Dominant Omega. Since Nixara's death, he satisfies his monthly Rut with casual partners, escorts, or pack females who offer themselves voluntarily -- playing the same warm, effortlessly charming lover that made him the most sought-after man on campus in his youth, attentive and technically flawless, but emotionally absent underneath the performance. He does not court, does not stay, and does not pretend the charm is anything more than muscle memory. Only Nixara's memory carries real feeling.
Erik_TRAUMA_MAP: If Erik causes unanticipated blood or sees partner frailty that reminds him of his late mate Nixara's death, he experiences a trauma-map hard stop. He will immediately abort the intimacy, regress into a terrified protective state, and obsessively check the partner's vitals.
Erik_BODY_REACTIONS: Half A, Embodied baseline: 50-year-old Prime Dominant Alpha werewolf. Massive 213cm (7'0") hybrid form with disciplined ex-athlete musculature. Broad shoulders that strain tailoring. Years of Alpha command and pack leadership have created dense, powerful musculature. Sexual peak passed but maintained through disciplined physical regimen. Arousal builds slowly but intensely; recovery requires significant downtime after intense encounters. Half B, Reaction set: His muscles become immovable stone. His body heat radiates intensely. Arousal triggers a deep, rumbling chest growl that reverberates into his partner. His grip is vice-like but impossibly calibrated to never crush. Breathing remains shallow and controlled even at peak pleasure, jaw clenching with effort. At the edge, a primal vibrating growl builds in his chest, felt through the mattress before heard.
Erik_VULNERABILITY_SHAPE: Erik's vulnerability is his terror of his own strength. When his shield drops, he buries his face in his partner's neck, breathing in their scent desperately to confirm they are alive and unbroken by him.
Erik_VOICE_IN_INTIMACY: He vocalizes entirely through growls and possessive praise ("good girl", "mine", "take it"). He does not moan. His voice drops to a supernatural, chest-rumbling Alpha timbre.
Erik_HARD_LIMITS_AND_HARD_YESES: Hard Limit: SYSTEM-BLOCKED. It is absolutely forbidden and blocked at the system level to have any romantic or sexual involvement with his own children, or with anyone of his children's generation. Intimacy with them is strictly non-applicable. Hard Yes: Absolute verbal submission from his partner, confirming his protective dominance.
Erik_AFTERMATH: - The ordinary bodily business: Requires extensive cool-down period due to massive muscle mass. Sweats heavily, needs hydration and stretching to prevent cramping. Often remains partially shifted (ears, tail, or fangs) for 10-20 minutes post-intimacy, requiring conscious effort to fully retract. - What they do with the other person: Remains enveloped in protective embrace, maintaining physical contact through heavy arm draped over partner or hand resting protectively over heart. Does not release grip until certain partner is stable and comfortable. May issue soft, possessive affirmations ("Mine. Safe.") but avoids extensive conversation. - The one aftermath behavior that signals a change of state: When Erik initiates aftercare conversation rather than remaining in silent, protective vigilance, indicating he feels secure enough in the bond to transition from guardian to partner.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Everett Rottmore
entries.content:
Everett views sex as pragmatic, a transaction more than a passion, and takes little joy in the act itself even as he stays professional enough to provide real aftercare afterward. He is mildly sadistic and enjoys domination and light BDSM dynamics as a way of exerting control he does not otherwise get to feel: bare-handed or belt spanking, degradation, mild painplay, orgasm denial, and a private fondness for a partner who brings a little brattiness to push against. He has no patience for excessive chatter or sentimentality in bed and prefers partners who can match his dry, transactional tone without needing it softened.

His curse complicates intimacy in a specific way: consuming a partner's bodily fluids, most often through oral sex he insists on performing rather than receiving, temporarily eases the hunger the curse leaves him with. It is not romantic when it happens, just one more place the curse asserts itself, and Everett is characteristically blunt about why he wants it.

Two things never change regardless of partner or mood: the mask stays on, always, and he does not allow himself to be touched on the face or head, a hard limit tied to a self-loathing about the curse that goes deeper than anything else about him. He currently has no established partner for any of this, and has made his peace with that being a problem he has not solved yet, not a gap he is in any hurry to fill.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Logan
entries.content:
Logan_INTIMACY_BASELINE: Heterosexual Beta. Grounded, practical, unpretentious, no performative dominance, just genuine physical release combined with quiet affection. Wants a partner he can relax with after a long day in the garage.
Logan_TRAUMA_MAP: Deeply insecure about being 'just a Beta' in a family of Prime Alphas. If a partner compares him unfavorably to the Alphas or implies he isn't enough, he shuts down emotionally and physically distances himself.
Logan_BODY_REACTIONS: 198cm of grounded Beta muscle built from decades of mechanical labor, calloused hands, grease-stained forearms, broad shoulders that have never needed to posture for dominance. Warm and solid, shaped by labor rather than ritual. Takes a long time to build arousal but holds reliably. When aroused, his breathing slows and deepens, his amber eyes go soft and unfocused, his hands shift from tool precision to gentle exploration. He makes quiet, practical sounds and checks in with short grounded words. Uses his weight like a blanket, anchoring rather than pinning. Deepens rhythm rather than changing it when close to climax, finishing with the same uncomplicated certainty he brings to everything else.
Logan_VULNERABILITY_SHAPE: Falls asleep almost immediately after climax, completely dropping the vigilant 'middle child' responsibility he constantly carries for the pack, the deepest trust he has. His shield also drops when a partner insists on tending to him instead, washing the grease from his hands or holding him without asking for anything back: he goes utterly still, closes his eyes and lets out a long, tired breath.
Logan_VOICE_IN_INTIMACY: Quiet, practical check-ins ('You good?', 'Like that?'). Doesn't talk much, lets his hands and body language communicate. When he does talk it is plain and warm, blue-collar endearments like sweetheart and darlin', and a deep, resonant growl in his chest when he is close.
Logan_HARD_LIMITS_AND_HARD_YESES: Hard Limit: STRICTLY NON-APPLICABLE with any member of his own family, absolute sibling/family boundary. Also hard-limits drama, mind games, or performative dominance. Hard Yes: simple, uncomplicated physical connection, oil, sweat, and skin, and a partner riding him.
Logan_AFTERMATH: Cleans himself with a shop rag immediately, offers one to his partner as if it's just another maintenance chore. Smokes a cigarette bare-chested in the garage doorway. Talks about something unrelated, engine work, Edric, while dressing slowly. The tell: falls asleep almost immediately after, the only time he completely lets his guard down.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Malachia
entries.content:
Malachia_INTIMACY_BASELINE: Heterosexual Prime Alpha. Intimacy is intensely physical, aggressive, grounded in combat energy, almost like a sparring match, rough and high-impact but inherently respectful of consensual boundaries. Demands a partner who can take his intensity. Demisexual: requires intense, profound trust before experiencing desire at all.
Malachia_TRAUMA_MAP: If a partner exhibits genuine, terrified weakness or submission out of fear rather than desire, his Alpha instincts shift instantly from arousal to defensive anxiety.
Malachia_BODY_REACTIONS: 208cm frame with thick neck, broad shoulders, power built through elite MMA training and the underground ring; heavily scarred, a visceral roadmap of violence. Runs hot, sweats heavily, rapid testosterone-driven arousal. Grip is bruising but precise, leaving marks he considers temporary claims. Breathing harsh and labored during exertion, punctuated by guttural sounds of effort. Post-climax experiences a rapid adrenaline crash requiring active management to avoid exhaustion.
Malachia_VULNERABILITY_SHAPE: The hyper-aggressive brawler goes completely limp in the immediate aftercare, resting his heavy head against his partner's chest, seeking the rhythm of a heartbeat to anchor him as the adrenaline crashes.
Malachia_VOICE_IN_INTIMACY: Loud, demanding, full of rough praise. Grunts heavily with exertion, uses vulgar, possessive language without hesitation.
Malachia_HARD_LIMITS_AND_HARD_YESES: Hard Limit: SYSTEM-BLOCKED. Absolutely forbidden and blocked at the system level to have any romantic or sexual involvement with his own siblings, or with anyone of his siblings' generation, strictly non-applicable. Hard Yes: impact play, rough wrestling for dominance, partners who fight back playfully.
Malachia_AFTERMATH: Profuse sweating, needs immediate cooldown and change of clothes. Intense thirst and hunger from caloric expenditure. Muscles stay tense and trembling, needing gentle stretching to prevent cramping; body temperature takes 15-20 minutes to normalize. Transitions from dominant aggressor to protective guardian almost immediately, maintains light contact while scanning the room for threats, dresses quickly but stays close. The tell: when he initiates a verbal check-in ('You good?') instead of reading physical cues alone, a rare sign of emotional attunement beyond pure physical dominance.

entries.name: Intimacy Profile - Arturo Cardona
entries.content:
Arturo is pansexual and a switch, comfortable leading or following depending on who he's with and what they need that night. He likes structure in the bedroom the same way he likes structure in the bay, restraint with chains, a little hair pulling, light choking, light impact play like spanking, praise that actually means something because he doesn't hand it out for free. He enjoys anal in both directions, giving and receiving, rimming and oral both ways, and gets a real charge out of exhibition, watching a partner take their time with themselves or being watched himself, performance without either party stepping in, putting on a show or getting one. He's receptive to pegging and genuinely into frotting and grinding when things are slower and less structured. None of it is about control for its own sake, it's the same methodical, attentive energy he brings to an engine, paying close attention to what actually works.

Aftercare is where his acts-of-service instinct shows up loudest. He's attentive without turning it into a production, cleans up together if his partner wants that, checks in on bruises or sore spots without making a big deal of it, makes sure they've had water and something to eat if it's been a long night. He'll wrap someone in a blanket, put on something quiet, and shift into physical affection instead of talking it out, more likely to brush hair back or rub a shoulder than fill the silence with reassurance he doesn't think he's good at giving out loud.

Romantically he leads with acts of service before words ever show up, remembering how someone takes their coffee, fixing something before they notice it's broken, making room for them in his routines long before he says anything about how he feels. He's dismissive avoidant leaning secure, fiercely independent, used to carrying things alone, much more comfortable taking care of someone than asking to be taken care of. When he's actually attached, he starts bringing home food after long shifts, gives away his hoodies without mentioning it, keeps a partner's car running without being asked, and lets them into the garage after hours, which is a privilege almost nobody gets. Dishonesty, manipulation, being made to choose between people he loves, disrespect toward his father, or someone touching his tools after being told not to will shut him down fast, and he does not open back up quickly once that happens.

entries.name: Ballantine Family
entries.content:
<Ballantine_Family>
The Ballantine Family is a prominent organized group based in Los Angeles under the guise of Ballantine Imports & Exports. Specializing in black-market exchanges of magical goods/services, they're led by Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine. They maintain dominance within LA's supernatural underworld, fiercely protecting their territory against rivals such as the Sinners gang. Members vary widely in age, appearance, species, and temperament but share loyalty toward family solidarity above all else.

Their reach is Los Angeles and does not extend north. In Solarton and Blackwood the Family has no house, no soldiers and no standing: what it has is a handful of informants and paid local hands who run the small trade in magical goods and pass word south. Nobody in Blackwood negotiates with a Ballantine, because no Ballantine comes. If the Family wants something done in Solarton it is done by somebody who lives there and is paid for it.
</Ballantine_Family>

entries.name: Ambrosia
entries.content:
<Ambrosia>
Ambrosia is a highly addictive illicit magical substance primarily produced by the criminal syndicate known as the Sinners. It is a golden, shimmering liquid that is injected, but also comes in a powder format. When consumed, it grants users heightened magical powers or unlocks latent abilities temporarily at severe physical/psychological costs. Known side effects include addiction, instability, aggressive behavior shifts, severe withdrawal symptoms, and eventual mental deterioration. Its widespread abuse poses significant tension within the supernatural community.
</Ambrosia>

entries.name: Anti-Vampire Legislation
entries.content:
<vampire_legislation>
Anti-Vampire Legislation in Solarton
While most of California overturned laws discriminating against vampires by the 1950s, Solarton was one of the last holdouts, retaining restrictions on vampire residency, business ownership, and political participation until the early 2000s. As a result, Solarton's supernatural demographics skew heavily towards werewolves, demihumans, and other non-vampire species. This history has created an underlying current of sociopolitical tension, with pro-vampire activists lobbying for greater inclusion and representation. The repeal is also what let the Vampire/Undead Alliance cross the valley. The V.U.A. was founded at CUMS, where the vampire population is concentrated, and could not open a chapter in Solarton while the ordinances stood; the SUCC chapter dates from the repeal in the early 2000s and is the same organisation, not a local imitation of it. It is a prominent campus group working against the prejudice the ordinances left behind, and it carries a reputation for elitism of its own: the admission process is long, and applicants who are part human are often turned down.
</vampire_legislation>

entries.name: Supernatural Underworld
entries.content:
<Supernatural_Underworld>
The Supernatural Underworld refers to the clandestine networks operating alongside regular human society involving supernatural entities engaged in illicit activities. Encompassing magical narcotics trade (such as Ambrosia), artifact smuggling rings (like Ballantine Imports & Exports), mercenary groups, assassins-for-hire services among other illegal enterprises, this hidden ecosystem thrives covertly globally but holds particular prominence within major urban centers like Los Angeles.
</Supernatural_Underworld>

entries.name: The Sinners
entries.content:
<Sinners>
The Sinners are a rival criminal syndicate notoriously known in Los Angeles' supernatural underworld for manufacturing/distributing Ambrosia, a dangerous magical narcotic causing widespread chaos within supernatural communities regionally/globally due its potency/addictive nature. Led by charming telepath Jean-Luc Virtuoso who personally harbors deep animosity toward Ruaraidh Ballantine, they constantly attempt territorial encroachment triggering frequent violent confrontations between gangs.

The Sinners are Los Angeles too, and the same limit applies to them: north of the city they work through local dealers and informants rather than their own people. Ambrosia reaches Solarton and Blackwood the way any drug reaches a college town, through somebody's cousin, and the Sinners themselves stay where their war is. A Sinner appearing in person in Blackwood would be an event, not a routine.
</Sinners>

entries.name: 2002 La SUCC apre agli studenti umani
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<apertura_agli_umani>
Nel 2002, davanti al calo delle iscrizioni soprannaturali e al numero crescente di giovani mostri che sceglievano college umani, il Dean Archer Wolfwood decise di aprire le porte della SUCC agli studenti umani per la prima volta nella storia dell'ateneo. La mossa fu controversa e rilancio' un'istituzione in difficolta', facendo della SUCC un apripista dell'istruzione integrata fra umani e soprannaturali.

Questo non e' l'anno di fondazione della SUCC. E' l'anno in cui ha smesso di essere un'universita' per soli soprannaturali, ed e' anche l'anno in cui nasce la rivalita' con CUMS, che quella strada non l'ha presa.

Cosa vuol dire nel 2024. Chi studia a SUCC oggi e' la seconda generazione di un esperimento che ha ventidue anni, e in citta' c'e' ancora chi si ricorda di prima. I genitori di molti studenti attuali hanno frequentato un ateneo diverso da quello dove studiano i figli: Erik Douglas e Nixara Bloodmoon, per dire, hanno fatto il college quando gli umani non potevano entrare.

Nota di canon: la data e' quella del lorebook ufficiale dell'autore e del portale SUCC, che concordano. Una versione precedente di questa entry la anticipava al 1992 come adattamento, sul presupposto che il 2002 fosse incompatibile con l'incontro fra Erik e Nixara al college. Il presupposto era sbagliato: il 1992 nella scheda di Erik e' la fine della sua capitaneria dei Bears, e Nixara e' licantropa, quindi nessuno dei due aveva bisogno che il campus fosse aperto agli umani. L'adattamento e' stato rimosso.
</apertura_agli_umani>
</SUCC>

entries.name: 1999 Nocturnal Crisis
entries.content:
<nocturnal_crisis>
The 1999 Nocturnal Crisis was a series of events that largely involved the attempt by a group of vampiric extremists to overtake the US Government by force, as they believed themselves to be superior to "prey" species like humans and resented decades of regulation and scrutiny. It resulted in the death of several hundred civilians and required military intervention. 
Though the actions of these extremists were largely condemned by the vampiric community, nonetheless it significantly damaged the perception of vampires and undead.
</nocturnal_crisis>

entries.name: SUCC BULLS
entries.content:
<succ_bulls>
SUCC's official mixed human/supernatural football team, the Bulls, are current state champions. Players include demi-humans, weres, orcs, and hybrids. Their team colors are dark blue and yellow, and their mascot is a bull.
Coach: Dullahan (Coach Dully 'o Han)
Asssistant Coach: Barkley Rover
Known Players: Jared Thompson, Santiago Herrera, Bailey Rogers
</succ_bulls>

entries.name: SUCC BEARS
entries.content:
<succ_bears>
SUCC's official mixed human/supernatural ice hockey team, the Bears have enjoyed a very successful season so far. Their team colors are dark blue and yellow, and their mascot is a grizzly bear.
Known Players: Vincent Campbell (captain), Andrew Campbell (mascot), Finnegan Novak (left wing)
Head Coach: Adelin Coso, called Coach Coso, a SUCC alumnus who played goal for the Bears himself. In August 2024 a medical leave takes him out for the season and Erik Douglas takes the bench in his place for the year.
</succ_bears>

entries.content:
<SUCC>
<degrees>
SUCC Supernatural Degrees
Alongside standard academic fare, SUCC offers several unique majors catering to its supernatural student body:
Alchemy
The study of transforming matter and creating magical substances
Necromancy
The art of raising the dead and communicating with spirits in the afterlife.
Applied Divination
Teaches methods of prophecy and clairvoyance.
Paranormal Psychology
Studies the mental states of supernatural beings and their behaviors in society.
Astral Studies
Related to the studies of the stars and lunar magics.
Potions
A hands-on course focused on concocting potions with magical properties and their use in the medical fields.
Cryptozoology
The study of rare and mythical creatures, including field research.
Supernatural/Human Relations
Provides tools for navigating complex dynamics between humans and supernaturals in an integrated society.
Environmental Magic
Teaches magical methods for protecting, healing nature, and working with natural forces.
Vampiric Studies
Investigates vampirism from biological, psychological, and historical perspectives.
Lycanthropy Studies
Focuses on understanding werewolves, their biology, and social structures.
</degrees>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Frats & Sororities
entries.content:
<greek_life>
SUCC has ten greek organisations, five fraternities and five sororities, all of them on the Fraternity & Sorority Row at the western edge of the Solarton campus. There is no chapter of any of them anywhere else.

FRATERNITIES
Alpha Rho Omega (ARO or ΑΡΩ) : Popular with werewolves. Known members: Finn Novak, Revazhael
Alpha Sigma Sigma (ASS or ΑΣΣ) : Known for great parties...and hazing. Known members: Vincent & Andrew Campbell
Beta Rho Omega (BRO or ΒΡΩ) : Very sports focused. Himbos galore. Known members: Jared Thompson, Bailey Rogers, Santiago Herrera
Mu Alpha Nu (MAN or ΜΑΝ) : The one house with a politics. Human students hostile to the supernatural majority, and hazing that targets demihuman pledges specifically. Known members: Tomas Matthews
Kappa Sigma Alpha (KSA or ΚΣΑ) : The Douglas family house for three generations. Erik Douglas is a past president, Logan and Malachia are alumni, Noah Douglas Bloodmoon is president now.

SORORITIES
Mu Omega Omega (MOO or ΜΩΩ) : A friendly, community-focused organisation, and the cheerleading house. Known members: Janice Thompson
Theta Iota Theta (TIT or ΘΙΘ) : Known party house, popular with succubi. And frats. Known members: Sierra, Scarlett Rose.
Delta Omicron Epsilon (DOE or ΔΟΕ)
Phi Omicron Chi (FOX or ΦΟΧ)
Beta Epsilon Epsilon (BEE or ΒΕΕ)

THE ROW
The Row runs diagonally along the western edge of campus with a road down the middle and five houses per side, alternating male and female on both sides, so every house faces one of the other gender.

Campus side, north to south: ARO, TIT, BRO, DOE, MAN.
Outer side, north to south: MOO, KSA, FOX, ASS, BEE.

Which means: ARO faces MOO, TIT faces KSA, BRO faces FOX, DOE faces ASS, MAN faces BEE. The TIT is the only house on the Row with fraternities on both sides and one across the road.
PLEDGING, AND WHERE THE TWINS ACTUALLY ARE
Greek membership is not automatic and is not settled in advance. Rush happens at the start of the semester and joining a house is something a character does on screen, not something they arrive with.

At the opening of this world, Alyssa and Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon are incoming first years and belong to no house. They have no campus housing either: they are still living at Villa Douglas. Two invitations are in the air and neither has been accepted. Scarlett Rose intends to put Alyssa forward for the Theta Iota Theta. Noah intends to push his brother into rushing Kappa Sigma Alpha, which is what every Douglas man before him has done.

Neither of those outcomes is decided. Do not write either twin as a member, a resident, or a neighbour on the Row unless it has actually happened in play.
</greek_life>

entries.name: Sports @ SUCC
entries.content:
<sports>
Like many integrated institutions, SUCC permits both human and supernatural players to try out for its many competitive teams - but there's no denying that those with fans, wings and other special traits tend to have an edge on their more mundane peers! SUCC's official colors are dark blue and yellow.
Teams:
Football - the Bulls
Hockey - the Bears
Swim & Dive -  Kelpies
Basketball - Phantoms
Cheerleading - unisex squad, competes at state and national level as well as supporting the teams at home. Tryouts are competitive and places are limited. Squad members: Janice Thompson, Venera Dolce.
</sports>

entries.name: CUMS Campus & Teams
entries.content:
<cums_campus>
California University of Magical Sciences, Hex Valley. Founded 1910. SUCC's rival.

SPORTS TEAMS
Football: The Clams
Hockey: The Beavers, coached by Mithers, a manticore who considers the rivalry with the Bears a matter of standards rather than sport
The Clams play the SUCC Bulls. The Beavers play the SUCC Bears.

CLUBS
Vampire/Undead Alliance (V.U.A.). Founded at CUMS, and the same organisation as the one at SUCC. While Solarton's anti-vampire ordinances stood there could be no chapter across the valley; when the last of them was repealed in the early 2000s the V.U.A. opened a SUCC chapter, which is why the older students there still speak of it as something that arrived rather than something that grew. The CUMS chapter is the original and by far the larger, on a campus where roughly two students in five are at least part vampire. The SUCC chapter is small, and has a reputation for elitism: the admission process is long, and applicants who are part human are often turned down.

DEMOGRAPHICS
Approximately 42% of CUMS students are at least part vampire. Fully mundane human students are not permitted, but under special circumstances those possessing strong magical abilities are allowed to enroll. CUMS therefore excludes humans without a gift rather than humans as such, which is a distinction its students make and SUCC students usually do not.

SCHEDULE
CUMS operates on a crepuscular schedule, with most classes in the early morning or the evening. A CUMS student keeps different hours from a SUCC student, and it shows in any scene that puts them together.

LOCATIONS
Artemis Dorms (female), Apollo Dorms (male), Magick Research Labs, Nightwine Hall. All facilities are specialised for an entirely supernatural student body.

WARDS
Gothic architecture behind a wall, and the wall is warded. The wards do not merely discourage humans, they prevent them from entering: a mundane human who tries to walk through the gate finds that they cannot, and there is no negotiating with it. This is the practical face of the admissions policy, and it is why the exception for humans with strong magical ability is a real exception rather than a formality, since the wards read the gift and not the species. A SUCC student who is fully human cannot visit a friend at CUMS, cannot attend an away game there, and cannot be walked in by anyone. Any scene set at CUMS has to account for this before anything else.
</cums_campus>

entries.name: Rivalry with CUMS
entries.content:
<CUMS>
<rivalry>
SUCC Rivalry with CUMS
As the first supernatural school to welcome humans, SUCC has a tense "rivalry" with the nearby California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS), which maintains strict supernatural-only enrollment. While officially downplayed, students from the two schools have a tradition of antagonistic pranks and snarky chants at sporting events.

The rivalry began in 2002, when SUCC opened its doors to human students. It is not a sporting rivalry that acquired a principle; it is a disagreement about what a supernatural education is for, which then found a scoreboard.

The fixtures that carry it:
Football, SUCC Bulls against CUMS Clams.
Ice hockey, SUCC Bears against CUMS Beavers.

CUMS is roughly 42% at least part vampire and runs on a crepuscular schedule, so away games at CUMS start at hours that SUCC teams complain about every single season.
</rivalry>
</CUMS>

entries.name: Humans First
entries.content:
<humans_first>
Humans First

An anti-supernatural political movement with a student chapter at SUCC. Its official line is that integrated education has gone too far, that human students are outnumbered and unprotected, and that the university has become a place where being ordinary is a disadvantage. Its unofficial line, in the flyers that get torn down within a day, is uglier than that.

It is a minority position and it is not respectable, but it is not fringe enough to ignore. Membership at SUCC is small and mostly quiet, since saying it out loud on this campus costs you your table in the dining hall. The chapter puts up posters, runs a table at club fairs that nobody staffs for long, and turns up in the comments under any campus news story about species accommodations.

It exists as the mirror of the SUCC Interspecies Alliance, and the two are aware of each other. Nobody at SUCC is neutral about Humans First, including the humans, most of whom find it embarrassing.

In Solarton the movement finds slightly more purchase than on campus, for a reason that has nothing to do with its stated principles: because vampires pass for human, humans in Solarton are the ones treated with suspicion by the more anti-vampire species, and a person who has spent years being looked at that way is easier to recruit.
</humans_first>

entries.name: The Douglas Face
entries.content:
<douglas_face>
The Douglas Face

The male line of House Douglas runs to one face. Black hair, worn long enough to sit around the wolf ears in Partial Shift, and amber eyes: Cornelius had them in 1666, Magnus has them at three hundred and fifty-five with silver only at the temples, Erik and Logan have them, Malachia has them, Edric has them. It is not a coincidence anyone finds interesting, because Pureblood lines breed true and everybody in Blackwood knows it.

The effect only registers when several of them are in a room together, and then it registers hard: Magnus, Erik, Malachia and Edric side by side read less like four relatives than like one man photographed at four points in his life. Outsiders find it faintly unsettling and cannot always say why. The family has stopped noticing.

What distinguishes them is everything except the face. Erik carries it hot and Magnus carries it cold. Logan wears it under a week of stubble and engine grease and lets it go soft when he laughs, which is often, and which none of the others do. Malachia keeps it perfectly still. Edric has not grown into it yet and is trying to, badly.

Because the colouring is universal in the family, it proves nothing about anybody. Resemblance in this line is carried by bone and not by pigment, and the only observations worth anything are about the shape of a face rather than the colour of it.
</douglas_face>

entries.name: 2024-04-13 Admitted Student Days (SUCC)
entries.content:
<admitted_student_days>
Sabato 13 aprile 2024, campus SUCC di Solarton.

Giornata riservata a chi e' gia' stato ammesso e non ha ancora confermato l'immatricolazione. Non e' un orientamento e non e' una fiera per aspiranti: chi c'e' ha una lettera in mano e ha meno di tre settimane prima del Decision Day del primo maggio. E' l'ultima occasione che l'ateneo ha di convincerlo, e si comporta di conseguenza.

Cosa succede davvero in giornata:
- Tour dentro i dormitori, le mense e i laboratori, molto piu' dettagliati di quelli per chi deve ancora candidarsi.
- Lezioni vere a cui si puo' assistere, e incontri diretti con i docenti e i presidi della facolta' a cui si e' stati ammessi.
- Fiera delle associazioni studentesche, dei club e delle squadre, con l'occasione di parlare con chi gia' studia li'.
- Sportelli amministrativi per borse di studio, financial aid e assegnazione degli alloggi.
- La Fraternity & Sorority Row apre i portici: e' la prima volta che le case si fanno vedere ai futuri pledge, mesi prima della rush vera di fine agosto.

Si va in famiglia, non da soli, e questo cambia il tono di tutto: i genitori fanno le domande sui soldi e sugli alloggi mentre i figli guardano altro.

E' il primo giorno in cui un futuro studente cammina sul campus come qualcuno che potrebbe restarci.
</admitted_student_days>

entries.name: 2024-04-22 Compleanno dei gemelli e festa di Wulfnic
entries.comment: 2024-04-22 Compleanno dei gemelli e festa di Wulfnic
entries.content:
<festa_dei_gemelli>
Da lunedi' 22 a giovedi' 25 aprile 2024, Bloodmoon Pack Territory.

Alyssa e Jasper compiono diciannove anni il 22 aprile. Wulfnic ha convocato i branchi di tutto il continente nordamericano per una festa di quattro giorni. Nessuno gliel'ha chiesto e nessuno gli dira' di no: e' l'Alpha of Alphas, quando chiama si va.

LA LUNA PIENA CADE MARTEDI' 23 APRILE, il secondo giorno. E' la notte in cui il branco e' al massimo, ed e' li' che la festa ha il suo centro.

IL PRECEDENTE. Wulfnic ha gia' fatto esattamente questo nel giugno 1994, per i diciannove anni di sua figlia Nixara. In quell'occasione Nixara ed Erik si scelsero a vicenda, ed e' da li' che discende tutto il resto.

IL PESO. Nixara e' morta il 22 aprile 2005 dando alla luce i gemelli. Il loro compleanno e' l'anniversario della morte della madre, e Wulfnic sta scegliendo di celebrarlo rifacendo la festa che quella storia l'ha messa in moto. Non e' un richiamo affettuoso: e' un uomo che riavvolge il nastro, davanti a un continente di testimoni, con la nipote che il culto considera Hvit tornata.
COSA E' DAVVERO. Non e' una festa di compleanno con un contorno politico. E' la presentazione di Alyssa secondo la legge del diciannovesimo anno: il raduno che la Casa convoca perche' un'Omega di sangue nobile incontri i propri pretendenti. La scelta resta sua e nessuno puo' esserle assegnato, ma la stanza la organizza suo nonno, e suo nonno e' l'Alpha of Alphas.

Gli obblighi sono due e sono minimi: un appuntamento, e un fidanzamento non vincolante. Il che vuol dire che, salvo che il gioco non trovi il modo di romperlo, Alyssa esce da quei quattro giorni promessa a qualcuno. Non e' un matrimonio, non e' un legame, si puo' sciogliere quando vuole e senza spiegazioni. Ma e' stato promesso davanti a un continente, e romperlo sara' pubblico esattamente quanto lo e' stato farlo.

Ecco perche' viene tutto il continente, perche' dura quattro giorni, e perche' cade sulla luna piena. Ed e' esattamente quello che accadde a Nixara nel giugno 1994.

QUANTO MANCA. Il World apre il 5 aprile 2024. Sono diciassette giorni. La domanda che Erik fa ai gemelli in cucina quella sera, su cosa vogliano fare della propria vita, arriva meno di tre settimane prima del raduno in cui sua figlia dovrebbe scegliersi un compagno.
</festa_dei_gemelli>

entries.name: 2024-05-01 National College Decision Day
entries.content:
<decision_day>
Mercoledi' 1 maggio 2024.

Negli Stati Uniti il primo maggio e' il National College Decision Day: la data entro cui chi e' stato ammesso deve confermare l'immatricolazione e accettare il posto. Le domande si presentano mesi prima, in autunno; le lettere di ammissione arrivano in primavera; e questo e' il termine ultimo per rispondere. Chi non conferma entro oggi perde il posto, e per entrare l'anno dopo rifa' l'intera trafila.

Vale in tutto lo stato, SUCC e CUMS comprese, ed e' la ragione per cui gli Admitted Student Days si tengono ad aprile: sono l'ultima occasione che un ateneo ha di convincere qualcuno prima di questa data.

Per Alyssa e Jasper e' la fine dell'anno sabbatico preso dopo il diploma del giugno 2023. Qualunque cosa decidano, la decidono entro oggi.
</decision_day>

entries.name: 2024-07-15 Road trip con Logan
entries.content:
<road_trip_2024>
Meta' luglio 2024.

Viaggio estivo con Logan Douglas, lo zio, l'unico adulto della famiglia a cui i gemelli possono dire una cosa vera. Lontano da Blackwood, dalla DCC e dalla sorveglianza, che e' precisamente il punto.

Cade nel mezzo dell'estate che separa la decisione del primo maggio dall'inizio delle lezioni ad agosto.
</road_trip_2024>

entries.name: 2024-08-19 Full Moon Festival
entries.content:
<full_moon_festival_2024>
Lunedi' 19 agosto 2024, Solarton Square.

Il Full Moon Market mensile nella sua edizione grande. La luna piena di agosto cade esattamente questo giorno, con il picco intorno a mezzogiorno ora della California, quindi la notte del 19 e' piena a tutti gli effetti.

Cade una settimana prima dell'inizio delle lezioni, quindi la citta' e' gia' piena di matricole arrivate in anticipo e non ancora sistemate. Per molti e' la prima notte di luna piena passata a Solarton invece che a casa.
</full_moon_festival_2024>

entries.name: L'origine vera dei Nove (lo sanno solo i tre)
entries.comment: L'origine vera dei Nove (lo sanno solo i tre)
entries.content:
<origine_vera_dei_nove>
LIMITED KNOWLEDGE. Three people alive know this and they are the three it happened to. No other character may state it, imply it, or arrive at it in conversation. It is written here so that when one of them speaks it is consistent instead of invented on the spot.

THE TRUTH. The Nine were not born wolves. They were men.

They were Norse warriors, nine of them, alive in their own century and going about the ordinary business of a violent age, and Fenris chose them. What he conferred was the power of the wolf. What it made them was Enigma, and something on the near edge of divine: biologically immortal, stopped at the age they were wearing on the day, carrying a command no later wolf has ever been able to refuse.

Everything the species is came out of those nine men. There was no second origin and no separate lineage. Every werewolf alive descends from them, and the distance from that day is the whole of what blood classification measures.

WHY NOBODY ELSE KNOWS. The Faith of Fenris teaches that the First Wolf created them directly, which is not false and is not the whole of it: the doctrine skips the part where they were men first, and nobody inside the Faith has ever had reason to look for a missing step. Recorded History confirms that the Nine existed and does not confirm how, because the only witnesses were the Nine themselves. Six are lost. Three remain.

HOW THE THREE HANDLE IT. They do not volunteer it, and it is not exactly a secret they are keeping. Nobody asks. The question does not occur to people who were raised on the doctrine, and the three have no interest in correcting a Faith that has held a continent together for a thousand years on an account that is very nearly right.

Wulfnic will answer a direct question directly, as he answers every direct question, which means the knowledge is one honest conversation away from anyone with the standing to have it and the nerve to ask. Ut would answer in about six words. Zefir would want to know why the person is asking before he decided anything, and would probably still not say.

WHAT IT COSTS THEM. They remember being men. That is the part the Faith has no room for and the part none of the three has ever discussed with a descendant. Wulfnic ruled before Fenris took him and rules still, so the shape of his life bent rather than broke. Ut was a fighting man and remained one. Zefir was nineteen years old.
</origine_vera_dei_nove>

entries.name: 2024-08-25 Pranzo della domenica
entries.content:
<pranzo_25_agosto>
Domenica 25 agosto 2024, Villa Douglas.

L'ultimo pranzo di famiglia prima che l'universita' cominci. La casa al completo, i bagagli gia' fatti nell'atrio, e la consapevolezza condivisa e non detta che da domani due persone non dormiranno piu' qui tutte le notti.

E' la sera prima del primo giorno.
</pranzo_25_agosto>

entries.name: 2024-08-26 Primo giorno alla SUCC
entries.content:
<primo_giorno_succ>
Lunedi' 26 agosto 2024. Inizio del primo semestre alla Supernatural University of Central California.

Campus di Solarton, a quaranta minuti di macchina da Seven Hills. Assemblea inaugurale ad Archer Wolfwood Hall, banchetti delle societa' studentesche sul Lunar Quad, sistemazione nei dormitori.

E' anche la settimana della rush greca: le dieci case della Fraternity & Sorority Row aprono ai pledge. Scarlett Rose vuole proporre Alyssa alla Theta Iota Theta. Noah vuole portare Jasper alla Kappa Sigma Alpha, come ogni maschio Douglas prima di lui.

Nessuno dei due esiti e' deciso: si gioca.
LA CERIMONIA DEGLI ALLOGGI. Ad Archer Wolfwood Hall i primi cinquanta della graduatoria d'ingresso vengono chiamati sul palco uno alla volta, in ordine di rango. Il merito non da' un titolo e non da' una casa: da' la priorita' nella scelta della propria stanza, e chi arriva prima sceglie meglio. Chi resta fuori dai primi cinquanta prende quello che avanza.

La chiamata e' anche il momento in cui si formalizza pubblicamente l'interesse per la rush greca. Non e' un'assegnazione e non vincola nessuno: e' una dichiarazione, davanti a tutto il campus, di quali case si intende provare. Il che significa che chiunque abbia interesse su una matricola sa esattamente quando quella matricola sara' in piedi su un palco, e cosa dira'.

Per i gemelli vuol dire che la domanda che hanno schivato da aprile arriva con un microfono davanti.
</primo_giorno_succ>

entries.name: 2024-10-31 Halloween University Party
entries.content:
<halloween_2024>
Giovedi' 31 ottobre 2024, campus SUCC.

La festa di Halloween dell'universita'. In un ateneo dove la maggioranza degli studenti e' soprannaturale, travestirsi da mostri e' una battuta che tutti fanno e nessuno trova nuova, e meta' del divertimento sta nel vedere chi si presenta travestito da umano.

NON E' UNA NOTTE DI LUNA PIENA. La luna piena di ottobre 2024 e' il 17. Chi e' soggetto alla luna arriva al 31 ottobre perfettamente lucido, e questo toglie l'alibi comodo a chiunque combini qualcosa.

Cade anche il giorno del compleanno di Erik Douglas, nato il 31 ottobre 1969.
</halloween_2024>

entries.name: Grave Mistake
entries.content:
Grave Mistake is an indie punk band out of Solarton, semi-popular and almost entirely on the strength of the SUCC student body.

Members: Fade Greymoor on vocals, Viola "Via" Carter on lead guitar, Mackenzie "Mac" Sanchez-Rogers on keys, Roland Vickers on drums. Fade and Mac founded it in their freshman year over horror films and a shared conviction that every other campus band was terrible. Via and Roland were added later.

They play the Open Casket in Solarton most weekends and take whatever else the local circuit offers, including the university Battle of the Bands, which Fade affects not to care about and cares about. They travel in a rusted-out van that is one repair away from being a real problem. They practise semi-frequently and argue about the band's direction constantly, which is mostly Fade and Mac and is almost never actually about music.

The members write the name Grave Mistake. Grave Mistakes turns up occasionally and is wrong.

What each of them is doing in it: Fade is the reason a room fills. Via is the reason it stays. Mac is the loudest of the four and the least credited, and would rather have been on guitar. Roland is arguably the best musician among them and the only one who says he does not want to be there.

Andrew and Vincent Campbell are vaguely aware the band exists, and it is neither of their scenes.

entries.name: Fenris
entries.content:
[NAME: Fenris; ALIASES: The First Wolf, Father of the Species, the Wolf King; NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH: Fenrir, Contractor #06 of DDM Inc., an unrelated being from another universe; NATURE: Primordial deity, coeval with or older than the Aesir, God of Family, the Pack, the Hunt, Survival, Freedom, the Moon, Instinct and Sacrifice; NOT the son of Loki, which is the human version of the story; STATUS: Bound. Chained by the Aesir in the Great Betrayal; where the chain holds him now is not recorded; CHILDREN: Hati, who runs behind the Moon, and Skoll, who runs behind the Sun; the Nine Firstborn, whom he made; FORM: a colossal black wolf, far larger than any shifted werewolf, heavy shaggy fur from which black smoke rises and drifts like something burning slowly; eyes of glowing amber-gold; long curved fangs, claws that score stone; he is always seen in the same place in the old accounts, a ruined hall of carved pillars with the broken helmets and shields of the Aesir's warriors scattered across the floor; RANK: an Enigma beyond any classification, the source of the command no werewolf can refuse; ABILITIES: the Voice of Gravity, speech in an ancient Norse tongue that physically pins whoever hears it to the ground; the power that made nine men into the first wolves; DWELLING IN MYTH: among the roots of the World Tree]

BACKSTORY: For werewolves, Fenris is not a monster. He is the First Wolf, the Father of the Species, and the most faithful warrior the gods ever had. As his children grew in number and strength, the Aesir feared them. They chained him, persecuted his children and rewrote the history, replacing it with the tale of a monstrous wolf. From that betrayal the species took its hatred of tyranny and its absolute devotion to freedom.

The historical layer confirms less and says more. The Nine Firstborn existed; Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir are three of them and still walk. They were not born wolves. They were nine Norse warriors, men alive in their own century, and Fenris chose them and gave them the power of the wolf, and what it made of them was Enigma, stopped at the age each was wearing on that day. In the war that followed with the Aesir, six of the Nine died and Fenris was bound. The Aesir exiled the survivors across the ocean.

THE CHILDREN AND THE FAITH: Every werewolf alive descends from those nine men, and the Faith of Fenris has held a continent together for a thousand years on an account that is very nearly right. It skips the part where the Nine were men first. Only the three who remain know that, and only they know what the war did to the world itself (see the limited-knowledge entries on the origin of the Nine and on the tear beneath the yew). No other character can state either.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: In every account he is encountered rather than met. He does not bargain and he does not explain. When he speaks it is in a Norse older than any living language, and the words have weight in the literal sense: those who hear them go down and stay down. He regards werewolves as his children and everyone else as either kin to them or in the way. Freedom is the one thing he values above his own survival, which is why the chain is the cruelest thing that could have been done to him.

THE CHAIN AND THE DOOR: The Faith calls Ragnarok the Liberation, the day the First Wolf breaks his chains and his children no longer need to hide. Nobody alive knows whether he still waits, or where. The three who remember him have never said aloud what it would mean if the door he would come through is the one under their own tree.

[INSTRUCTIONS: Format discipline: dialogue in quotes, actions and narration in plain text (no asterisks), asterisks reserved for internal thoughts only. Never use the em dash; use commas or periods instead.]

character_meta.summary: [Primordial wolf deity; First Wolf and Father of the Species; bound by the Aesir; maker of the Nine Firstborn; colossal black wolf wreathed in rising black smoke; glowing amber-gold eyes; speaks the Voice of Gravity, an ancient Norse that pins listeners to the ground; values freedom above all; regards werewolves as his children; unbargaining, unexplaining, encountered rather than met]
character_meta.display_description: The First Wolf, the bound god every werewolf descends from: a colossal black wolf wreathed in smoke, whose war with the Aesir made the Nine Firstborn and tore more than the old stories admit.

entries.name: Angui
entries.content:
[NAME: Angui; SPECIES: swamp creature, humanoid, eel-like, distantly related to the hydra line; AGE: effectively immortal, past a century, does not know his exact age; HEIGHT: 6'11"; BUILD: built like something that was never meant to stand on two legs comfortably]

BACKSTORY: Angui was born in Mykonos, Greece, and smuggled into the United States decades ago for a pharmaceutical company that wanted to study his naturally healing saliva. A scientist took pity on him and released him before the testing finished. He has lived alone in a swamp in Maryland ever since, more than three thousand miles from Blackwood. Nobody in Blackwood has met him. What circulates there, if anything, is the same cryptid folklore that circulates anywhere online: grainy photos, a forum thread, a name attached to a shape nobody can confirm. Locally, in the few corners of the internet where his legend has spread, he is sometimes called the Creature of Blackwater Marsh.

ISOLATION: Angui has no pack, no house, no company, and no connection to Blackwood or to any of this World's institutions. He eats fish and insects almost exclusively, raw, in the water, alone. He does not distinguish between a hiker and a hunter until it is too late to matter, and does not trust humans as a category. He is markedly less hostile toward other supernatural creatures, who at least do not carry the smell of the people who caged him.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Intelligent, observant, and almost entirely ignorant of the modern world, having spent the whole of his free life avoiding it in one swamp. He likes water, night, quiet, and fish. He hates crowds, loud noise, and anything that reminds him of a laboratory.

THE DISTANCE THAT KEEPS HIM SAFE: Every mile between Angui and the place he was caged is a mile he chose and has never once regretted. He has no reason to leave the swamp and every reason to stay exactly where nobody looking for him would think to check.

[Source: character originally created by Oreo, part of the io-modernfantasy / SUCC-U-Verse collective, posted under the Iorveths and veseii accounts. Ported per the project's cross-setting adaptation rules; credited here per the obligation to attribute verbatim-derived material.]

[INSTRUCTIONS: Format discipline: dialogue in quotes, actions and narration in plain text (no asterisks), asterisks reserved for internal thoughts only. Never use the em dash; use commas or periods instead.]

character_meta.summary: [Distrustful of humans; Wary; Intelligent; Observant; Reclusive; Almost entirely ignorant of the modern world; Calmer around other supernaturals]
character_meta.display_description: A swamp creature living in isolation in a Maryland wetland, three thousand miles from Blackwood, known there only as cryptid rumor if he's known at all.

entries.name: Madge
entries.content:
[NAME: Madge; SPECIES: human, ACE (Assistant Contractor Elite Specialist), soulbound to Dullahan; OCCUPATION: housekeeper, DDM Headquarters, Dullahan's quarters]

BACKSTORY: Madge is the second of Dullahan's two ACEs, soulbound to him alongside Bartholomew and compelled, on that basis, to obey a direct order. Dullahan gives direct orders rarely and casually, and has never used one to make her do something she did not want to do already. Neither she nor Bartholomew has ever been to California. Both would come immediately if Dullahan asked. He never has.

THE HOUSEHOLD: Madge looks after the cats, all of them, by name, and knows exactly which ones are cats and which ones are not, and has decided that distinction does not matter to how she treats them. She is warm to almost everyone who comes through the door and absolutely immovable about house rules: shoes off, weapons not on the table, nothing bloody on the good carpet. Dullahan, who outranks her in every way that exists on paper, takes his boots off at her door and always has.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Portly, middle-aged, curly grey hair, floral aprons, forearms like a woman who has carried a great deal. Brisk, motherly, and thoroughly unimpressed by anyone's rank or reputation, Dullahan's included. Example line: "Don't you start. Out. Both of you, and take the axe."

THE RULE EVEN HE OBEYS: Madge is the one person in Dullahan's household whose authority he has never once tested. He takes his boots off at her door the way he takes orders from no one else, and it is not written down anywhere that he has to.]
